description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Reserved - Special Commodity Levy on Clementines - Fresh, Clementines - Dried and others
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures specifying tax rates for various commodities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa is incidental to the regulatory action being taken, not the primary focus of the gazette.
